name: get_qqq_gex_retained_summary
description: Count locally retained GEX published/partial dates and observed inputs without reading full profiles. Counts are evidence inventory, not complete market coverage or payload-integrity certification.

name: rebuild_qqq_gex_history
description: Resume bounded imports of locally retained normalized observations through the original algorithm. Each input commits independently; failures persist and are retried only when requested. Never fills unavailable history.

limit.description: limit argument for rebuild_qqq_gex_history; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

retryFailed.description: retryFailed argument for rebuild_qqq_gex_history; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

name: get_qqq_gex_replay
description: Compute original causal directional replay from local imported history only. Range is bounded to 366 days; ranges above 32 days use original daily summaries; missing data/runtime is explicit and no remote source is consulted.

page.description: page argument for get_qqq_gex_replay; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

pageSize.description: pageSize argument for get_qqq_gex_replay; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

name: calculate_qqq_gex_local
description: Run the bundled original GEX algorithm on the previously captured local normalized input and atomically publish its local display resources. Uses the bundled pinned Node runtime; reports unavailable or invalid input rather than installing a runtime or inventing data.
